text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O's race got underway. As I 
watched with bated breath—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello there, Chiyo-chan's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, did that startle you? But I can't 
keep you company right now.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The same goes for you, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of Maruzensky's gaze was Sakura 
Chiyono O rounding the corner.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, they're charging up the hill! Win or 
lose, this is the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is Chiyono O struggling?! Now, who will 
break out to the front?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (...My lungs hurt.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crack...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Kh... *pant*... Just a little more... Just 
a bit...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(It feels like my heart's about to burst. 
Thump, thump, like it's going to break—)

text_block_list.name: Creek & Oguri
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaahhh! Haaaaaaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crack-crack-crack-crack...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It felt—as if my very body were crumbling 
away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Spilling away piece by piece, it felt as 
if going any further would break "me" 
apart.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...I'm scared.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My body is tearing apart, crumbling away. 
I have no desire to see the tragic future 
that awaits me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Something like this—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crack-crack-crack-crack-crack—...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Don't shatter!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If I must shatter, then let me split!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's right! You must have things you 
refuse to compromise on too! In that case, 
there's no need to be held back by the 
past!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Being fully prepared for all of that—

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Yaeno
text_block_list.text: —I will!! —It is I who will!!

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Yaeno
text_block_list.text: I'm going to beat you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Sakura Chiyono O faced forward once more.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Go-o-o! Oguri-! Move up, move up! Inari's 
closing in too!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Creek, don't lose! This is the shield 
that belongs to you!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hear cheers for the other Umamusume. 
Most of them are rooting for the Eternal 
Big Three.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if I shout amidst all this noise, my 
voice might not reach her. Even so, 
however...
choice_data_list: Go, Chiyono O, you can do it—gooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I *can't* go back to the way 
I was! I *won't* go back...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna become... a brand new me!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (VRRRROOOOOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Would you look at that! Are the cherry 
blossoms blooming once again this autumn?! 
Sakura Chiyono O takes the lead! Chiyono O 
in the lead! Charging straight ahead—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O crosses the finish line! 
Unbelievable, Sakura Chiyono O takes 1st 
place!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer...-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! I won. I actually won...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
See? As long as you don't give up on 
yourself, you'll receive wonderful gifts, 
won't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen-san...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what... Maruzensky-san?! Wh-why are you 
hereâ

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell you the reason la~ter♪ I won't 
cause any trouble, okay?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Chiyo-chan. You understand now, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You have now acquired a new running style 
as Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And I'm sure that's thanks to your rivals, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That is precisely what makes you my 
"rival."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
As long as the fire inside our hearts 
keeps burning hot, we can keep on running.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now, hungry wolf who still craves a feast 
even after claiming the summit.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Why don't you race me next time?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Could you escort Chiyo-chan up to 
that point?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-Wh... What a terrible turn of 
events!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
That "Monster" Maruzensky has declared 
Sakura Chiyono O her rival!! And they're 
facing off in this year's Japan Cup, no 
less!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheers that were truly like an earthquake. 
Tokyo Racecourse shook violently.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And that passion carries over into the 
race of their promise. Flowing toward the 
"Japan Cup"...!
